continuity.runtimeContinuity: App/storage/transaction/reward code unchanged after tested head through audited head.

implementedProtections.purchase: applyPermanentPurchase revalidates current owned/stars/coins state in the functional transaction, records a durable per-item purchase receipt, charges once, and restores ownership from a receipt without charging again.
implementedProtections.questCompletion: Final correct-answer state applies the +30 Coins/+30 XP/Quest/Bond/daily completion transaction atomically with an active/completed Quest receipt; the 950 ms timer is presentation/transition only.

implementedProtections.missingArt: Owned/equipped/room/Dream Goal IDs are shape-sanitized only and are never filtered against current catalog-art availability.
